along the lines of what they said (Sanhedrin 91a):
those who were, all the more so.
But for his dust to be stirred,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (סוֹטָה כא, א)
along the lines of what they said (Sotah 21a):
(Mishlei 6:22) "When you lie down it will guard over you":
"and when you awaken it will converse with you":
רַק מִי שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה שָׁכֵן לֶעָפָר בְּחַיָּיו
only by one who becomes a neighbor of dust in his lifetime,
who is like dust in his own eyes.
And this is what terumas hadeshen indicates;
and this is the connection of the mitzvah of terumas hadeshen
to "this is the law of the olah on its pyre":
that the haughty one falls into fire,
and Yisrael, who are despised and lowly,
And this is one who merits that his dust be stirred;
can reach the attribute of humility,
and death is only like sleep,
"and when you awaken it will converse with you."
